title: Disabled account still holds a privileged role

report.title: {Items.Count} disabled {Plural(Items.Count, 'account holds', 'accounts hold')} a privileged role

messages.businessImpact: A disabled account cannot sign in today, but the rights remain attached, so re-enabling it, by mistake or by an attacker, restores administrative access immediately.
remediation: Remove the role assignment as part of the leavers process rather than relying on the account being disabled.
